main_text.p: Quòd si præ virium imbecillitate absolu-tam inediam ægri diu ferre nequeant, saltè tenui victu utatur perpetuò. Panis esto hor-deaceus, aut triticeus & recens. Olera, se-ris hortensis, beta, lactuca, buglossum, hor-deum percoctum, oxalis, quæ maximè bi-liosæ elephatiæ conveniunt: dein apij hor-tensis, quòd petroselinum pharmacopolæ nominant, radices, atq; etiam fœniculi folia & radices, capparum fructus & radices. Carnes vero sunto boni succi lac cum mel-lis, aut sacchari pauco à veteribus plurimū commendatur. Est enim boni succi, & facilis concoctionis. Addè quòd adeò huic morbo adversatur, ut frequeri eius usu Scythæ regionem frigidissimâ incolentes incolumes servetur: quemadmodum ex Ga-leni sententia ostendimus. Serum autem eius scilsi adhuc multo pluris ab ipsis pri-scis fit, de quo, non ut alimento, sed medi-çamento utendum est. Veruntamen ex eo non minus tribus heminis accipiedum es-se suadet Aëtius. Non solùm extersoriâ vim habet, sed & subducendi ventris gratia as-sumitur, tum in potu, tu per clysterem infu-sum. Gallinarum quoq; ova recenter posi-ta, sorbilia mirum in modum commendât pra-

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "extersoriâ" (the long-s word before "viâ"; read as printed, not confirmed). The abbreviation "atq;" and "quoq;" are copied from a semicolon-like mark, which is uncertain (the scan may show a z-like sign). "Pra-" is the catchword. The first line may continue from the previous page; the page does not show an indent, so no cont="true" was set. The printed spelling "Est" follows "commendatur." without a space, which is a printing fault kept as printed. The original has "scilsi", "fcis", "scis" variants, which are kept as printed with plain s.
